run_metaquery_training: run the MetaQuery training script with custom model and training arguments via CLI
create_model_arguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure VAE, MLLM, diffusion model, and metaquery hyperparameters
create_training_arguments: create a TrainingArguments dataclass to configure optimizer, learning rate, batch size, and evaluation strategy
create_data_arguments: create a DataArguments dataclass to configure training datasets, eval dataset, and target image size
resume_metaquery_checkpoint: resume MetaQuery training from the newest checkpoint in a specified directory
